main_topics.reason: User came to understand what POTS means and asked what it is, why it happened and whether it is permanent across many turns.
User said fear of a damaged heart was what scared them and later reported feeling less panicked.
User asked what they can do and wrote down salt, fluids, compression and in-the-moment steps.
User was confused and scared of exercise because pushing causes multi-day crashes, and spent a few turns on it.
User asked whether POTS is permanent in one question with a substantive answer.
User described pounding heart, dizziness and spotty vision on standing and asked how to stop episodes faster.
User asked once whether they should be on medication and got a general answer.
User mentioned the doctor said it fast and later said the chat was more useful than the appointment.
User asked why long COVID caused POTS after being healthy before.

output.summary: A user newly told they have POTS after four months of long COVID asked what it means, why it happened, whether it is permanent and what they can do. The bot explained it clearly, reassured them that the heart is not damaged, and gave self-management steps and in-the-moment tips while acknowledging the tension with post-exertional crashes. The user said they felt much less panicked and had notes and questions for their next appointment.
